get_colormap_rgb: get all 100 RGB colors as a numpy array scaled to 0-255 range
get_colormap_bgr: get all 100 BGR colors as a numpy array scaled to 0-255 range
get_colormap_normalized: get all 100 RGB colors as a numpy array normalized to 0-1 range
get_random_color_rgb: get a single random RGB color from the colormap scaled to 0-255
get_random_color_bgr: get a single random BGR color from the colormap scaled to 0-255
